# TEST DATA ONLY

These documents exist so the conversation suites can exercise the grounding rules with the
Firestore *shapes* from vr_plan.md §10. They are not the owner's menu. The real
`businesses/{businessId}` data is owned by the dashboard team (plan 0004, open question 2).

`menu_items.json` → `businesses/{businessId}/menuItems/{itemId}`
`facts.json` → `businesses/{businessId}/facts/{factKey}`
`capacity_slots.json` → `businesses/{businessId}/capacitySlots/{slotId}` (Phase 4)
